about: Ternopil: a lakeside city with active construction

Ternopil is a compact city around the large Ternopil Pond. In recent years many new residential complexes have gone up here, some overlooking the water, while estates such as Druzhba and Skhidnyi have plenty of standard flats being updated.
Many Ternopil residents work abroad and buy an apartment for the future, so the renovation has to be visible from a distance: photo reports, online approvals and, if desired, a camera on site.

In new complexes — an open plan arranged for a specific family, with walk-in wardrobes and space for laundry. For apartments with a view of the lake — an interior that brings out the view, with the right curtains and lighting. Design project from $30 per m² (minimum $2,500); packages are on the [interior design studio](/en/interior-design) page.

We renovate shell-condition and resale apartments as well as houses. In the suburbs of Ternopil we build aerated-block, brick and timber-frame houses; project, shell and finishing can be split into stages.

Renovation is carried out by our salaried team: from $550 per m² for works and rough materials, with finishing materials, furniture and appliances priced separately per estimate. Scope, schedule and payment plan (50/50, 50/30/20 or in stages, from a 10% advance) are fixed in the contract; team travel is on individual terms. Architectural design from $12 per m², house shell from $600 per m², turnkey with finishing from $1,100 per m² — see [turnkey renovation](/en/turnkey-renovation) and [house construction](/en/house-construction).

Design and approvals run online; we travel for measurements and key stages on the schedule set in the contract, and the terms and costs of travel and team accommodation are individual. Between visits you get photo reports every 1–2 weeks, and an online camera on site 24/7 is available for an extra fee.

faq: I live abroad. Can the renovation in Ternopil be managed remotely?
Yes: approvals online, photo reports every 1–2 weeks and an online camera 24/7 for an extra fee. The contract and payments can also be arranged remotely.
How much does a design project in Ternopil cost?
From $30 per m², minimum $2,500. The planning package starts from $6 per m², the full package with designer supervision from $45 per m².
Who will work on the site?
Our own salaried team, covering different levels of complexity and types of work. 12-month warranty on works.
